proof.text: Form the natural transformation alpha from reduced level-m evaluation to level-n evaluation by adjunction from the strict derived transition. Its naturality follows from Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_square applied to coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition.naturality. Whisker the evaluation tensor comparison and the quotient tensor comparison, then compose with the tensor of alpha with itself to form s. Form t by applying alpha to the system tensor and then the level-n evaluation tensor comparison. Both are natural transformations between the same bifunctors.

For each derived system choose a complex representative using the essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q, and apply the existing independent-coefficient K-flat resolution theorem on the coefficient sequence site. Localizing its quasi-isomorphism and composing with the representative isomorphism gives an isomorphism from the image of a K-flat complex to the original object.

Take the product of the two resolution isomorphisms. Apply the supplied hrep hypothesis at the K-flat pair to identify s and t there. Naturality gives equality after precomposing s and t at the original pair by the source bifunctor applied to this product isomorphism. Cancel that isomorphism to obtain the stated equality. This includes n=m and requires no normalization or boundedness of the objects.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 06YS (lemma-K-flat-resolution), adjunction naturality and cancellation along the product of the localized resolution isomorphisms

title: Transport of normalized tensor horizontality from representatives
statement:
theorem coefficientNormalizedTensorHorizontalTransport
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hE : CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E W R)
    (Q : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
    (hrep : ∀ (P V : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
        (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) P →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
        (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) V →
      ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        (coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E W h).map
            ((R.evaluationTensor m).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj V)) ≫
          (Q.tensor h).hom.app
            ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W m).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
              (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W m).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj V)) ≫
          (R.finiteClosed n).tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom
              (coefficientSequenceTransitionAdjoint l E W
                R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors Q h (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
              (coefficientSequenceTransitionAdjoint l E W
                R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors Q h (DerivedCategory.Q.obj V))) =
        coefficientSequenceTransitionAdjoint l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors Q h
            (R.systemClosed.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj V)) ≫
          (R.evaluationTensor n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj V))
    (P V : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    (coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E W h).map
        ((R.evaluationTensor m).hom.app (P, V)) ≫
      (Q.tensor h).hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W m).obj P,
          (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W m).obj V) ≫
      (R.finiteClosed n).tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom
          (coefficientSequenceTransitionAdjoint l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors Q h P)
          (coefficientSequenceTransitionAdjoint l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors Q h V)) =
    coefficientSequenceTransitionAdjoint l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors Q h
        (R.systemClosed.tensor.obj (P, V)) ≫
      (R.evaluationTensor n).hom.app (P, V)
